builds.summary: Score Q Power Chord Staccato bonus with level breakpoint base+.3 AP, not the basic attack physical damage; AP/penetration raises the chord itself.
builds.goal: Score Q Power Chord Staccato bonus with level breakpoint base+.3 AP, not the basic attack physical damage; AP/penetration raises the chord itself.
builds.hypothesis:
Sona deals [50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody. Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for [3] seconds, granting allied champions an additional [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage %i:OnHit% on their next Attack within [5] seconds.

Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage ([characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=15, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 22.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.3) × AP] total magic damage).
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.name: Staccato: Q-enhanced Power Chord
builds.summary: Investigate high one Q-enhanced Staccato magic packet output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Q-enhanced Staccato magic packet output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The ordinary Power Chord helper is a champion-level breakpoint base + 0.2 AP magic. Q replaces it with Staccato, whose helper uses a 1.5-times larger breakpoint base and 0.3 AP. This is a replacement packet, not normal Power Chord plus Staccato. Q aura on-hit is another source.

kitEvidence.formula:
Accelerando: Sona gains Accelerando stacks from using her Basic Abilities well. She gains +%i:scaleAH% [0.5] Basic Ability Haste permanently per stack, up to %i:scaleAH% [60] Basic Ability Haste. When she reaches %i:scaleAH% [60] Basic Ability Haste, instead of gaining further stacks her current Ultimate Ability's cooldown is reduced by @Spell.SonaPassive:AccelerandoUltCDR@ seconds.

Power Chord: After using [3] basic Abilities, Sona's next Attack deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=10, changes=[{"mLevel": 9, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage and may have an additional effect based on the song Sona last activated.
Hymn of Valor: The Attack deals @Spell.SonaQ:TotalStaccatoDamage@ magic damage instead.Aria of Perseverance: The target deals @Spell.SonaW:TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@ less damage for @Spell.SonaW:DiminuendoDuration@ seconds.Song of Celerity: The target is Slowed by @Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@ for @Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@ seconds.
